references.description: Exact existing Markdown paths relative to the supplied skills root, beginning with the owning skill folder. Preserve filename case; omit a leading skills/ or absolute path prefix.

actions.description: Role actions select source profiles: delegate-reviewer-review selects reviewer for ordinary independent substantive review; delegate-oracle-review and consult-oracle select oracle for an explicit request, a one-way-door or hot-path review lane, or a concrete blocker remaining after investigation or ordinary review; delegate-design-reviewer-review selects design_reviewer for the second-family review on the first full pass of the default or separable lane (never on delta or mechanical passes); reconcile-oracle-with-judge runs both oracle seats and has a judge reconcile them in the one-way-door or hot-path lane; run-blast-radius-pass finds and proves the one fact a one-way or hot-path change is safe because of; delegate-fast-review selects fast_reviewer; delegate-command-verification selects verifier. select-minimum-useful-reviewers picks the smallest reviewer set the review lane allows for any substantive pass, including a delta pass; account-for-all-review-topics accounts for every checklist topic as covered or not material; confirm-final-review-coverage confirms that every required track returned before completion. delegate-standards-intent-simplification assigns those checks to independent reviewers within the requested scope, including a delta reviewer's scope. delegate-one-coupled-review groups coupled topics with one independent reviewer. delegate-independent-tracks assigns bounded material review tracks; dispatch-independent-tracks-in-parallel starts separable tracks together when capacity is available. use-built-in-review-agent applies the host-provided defect-review skill. keep-reviewers-nonrecursive prevents children from spawning agents or invoking the outer review gate. retain-main-review-ownership keeps orchestration, finding judgment, fixes, verification, and completion with the main agent, whose own inspection cannot supply review coverage. report-blocked-review-coverage reports unavailable independent coverage without claiming completion. keep-coupled-review-local means review performed by the main agent without independent reviewer coverage. dispatch-refiner-for-clear-standards-fixes sends behavior-preserving Standards findings tagged fix: clear to the refiner role; delta-review-by-non-author has a read-only reviewer that did not write the edits review them. list-audit-item-without-fixing lists a finding tagged origin: touched and fix: audit, as the coding standards define them, under ## Audit items and leaves it unfixed. run-large-change-audits has independent reviewers run improve-codebase-architecture and improve-test-suite on the touched subsystems when the diff adds a module or subsystem or changes more than about 500 non-generated source lines.
